summary_en: DOWA Holdings authorized acquisition of up to 2.4 million shares (4.06% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 16.0 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 12, 2026 to March 31, 2027, to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Pertaining to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 11, 2026, DOWA Holdings' board of directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock pursuant to provisions in its articles of incorporation under Article 459, Paragraph 1 of the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 2.4 million shares of its common stock, representing 4.06% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum aggregate consideration of 16.0 billion yen. Acquisitions will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from November 12, 2026 through March 31, 2027.

The company stated that the purpose of the buyback is to enhance shareholder returns while improving capital efficiency and increasing corporate value. As of September 30, 2026, DOWA Holdings had 59,159,987 issued shares excluding treasury stock and held 2,829,219 shares of treasury stock.
